type.description: The type id of the response

kind.description: The kind of instance, server, cluster or super-cluster

cluster.description: The cluster the server is in

port.description: The client port, or the port of the client proxy for an instance created with toxics

ports.description: Further ports by listener name, such as cluster and trace

advertise.description: The configured client_advertise host, empty when the node advertises nothing

trace_url.description: The URL of the server's capture proxy, set client-side from the trace port

version.description: The server version the node runs, set by status only

shaping_sets.description: The ids of the shaping sets applied to the instance's capture proxies, in the order they were first applied

backend.description: The name of the backend running the instance's servers

capabilities.description: The capabilities the backend declares, such as kill, pause and version-change

agent.description: The name of the service's network agent, absent when it has none

agent_capabilities.description: The capabilities the agent declares, such as capture and shaping

name.description: The link's name, route:<node>-><node>, gateway:<cluster>-><node> or client:<node>

kind.description: The link's kind, route, gateway or client

from.description: The node that dials through a route proxy, or the cluster whose nodes dial through a gateway proxy, empty for a client proxy

to.description: The node the proxy forwards to

proxy.description: The host:port the nodes or clients dial the proxy on

upstream.description: The host:port the proxy forwards to

links.description: The proxied links of an instance created with toxics

name.description: The toxic's name, unique on the instance

kind.description: The kind of link, route, gateway or client, every kind when empty

from.description: A node or a cluster at one end of the links, any when empty

to.description: A node or a cluster at the other end of the links, or the server of a client link, any when empty

node.description: Selects every link of one node both ways, not combined with from or to

direction.description: The data the toxic acts on, to, from or both, both when empty

selector.description: The links the toxic acts on

attributes.description: The attributes of the toxic's type

toxicity.description: The chance in [0, 1] that the toxic acts, 1 when absent

links.description: The names of the links the selector resolved to

toxics.description: The toxics in place on the links of an instance created with toxics, in the order they were added

events_seq.description: The stream sequence of the latest service event of the instance, absent when there is none

instances.description: The status of each instance reported
